apis.description: Create, get or delete lookup key(s) for a database.

operations.summary:
LOOKUP KEYS API:
Create a lookup key for a database field.
operations.notes: The lookup key's info will be returned, if it is successfully created or already exists. The lookup key cannot be used until it reaches an ACTIVE status.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: Database ID for a database with no unique identifier.

parameters.name: database field name
parameters.description: Name of the field that you want to create a lookup key for.

parameters.name: Request Body
parameters.description: No data is required in the request body. Just provide a blank json.

operations.summary:
LOOKUP KEYS API:
Get the lookup key for a database field.
operations.notes: The lookup key's info will be returned, if it exists. The lookup key cannot be used until it reaches an ACTIVE status.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: Database ID

parameters.name: database field name
parameters.description: Name of the database field.

operations.summary:
LOOKUP KEYS API:
Delete the lookup key for a database field.
operations.notes: The lookup key will be deleted, if allowed.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: Database ID

parameters.name: database field name
parameters.description: Name of the database field.
